capabilities: Paginate Markdown notes into horizontally flippable single or two-page spreads
Track reading position with text anchors, bookmarks, table of contents, and full-book search
Adjust reading appearance (font, tint, brightness, margins) and immersive/full-screen mode
Import FB2, EPUB, and TXT books into Markdown with images, footnotes, and covers
Save selected text as quotes in a per-book note with source links
disambiguation: Not a Markdown viewer or exporter; it only displays notes as fixed e-book pages and imports e-book files into the vault.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. One mobile setting (hiding the OS status bar) is marked experimental. Books imported before version 2.1 have footnotes baked in and need re-import for the new footnote display.
problem: Obsidian only shows notes as vertically scrolling documents, so reading long texts like books is awkward, and e-book files cannot be read or imported as notes.
summary: E-book-style reader that paginates Markdown notes into flippable pages, with bookmarks, progress tracking, quotes, and FB2/EPUB/TXT import.
